# Swift Junk Removal

> Licensed and insured junk removal for homes, job sites and businesses in Las Vegas and Henderson, Nevada. Call or text (702) 929-6544. Email swift-junkremoval@outlook.com.

Swift Junk Removal removes furniture, mattresses, appliances, electronics, yard debris, construction and renovation waste, and runs garage, attic, storage, estate and move-out cleanouts. Customers speak directly with the team, not a call center. Pricing is quoted per job after a call or a photo.
